title: Pan-Seared Chicken Breast with Italian Skillet
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish that combines the flavors of Italy with the tenderness of chicken breast.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Add the olive oil to the skillet and sear the chicken breast for 5-6 minutes per side.
Remove the chicken breast from the skillet and set aside.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Return the chicken breast to the skillet and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes or until cooked through.
